data.name: RedNodeLoader
data.description:
Mod to load all mods made with [RedNodeEditor](https://github.com/ImAxel0/RedNodeEditor) application. (`.rmod` files)

### RedNodeEditor
It's an application to make mods for SonsOfTheForest by connecting different node blocks. Two project examples are included with installation:
- A smaller version of [Axel's Mod Menu](https://sotf-mods.com/mods/imaxel/axel's-mod-menu)
- Nearly the entire [Plane Mod](https://sotf-mods.com/mods/imaxel/plane-mod)

#### Official mods website
https://rednodemods.web.app/

#### Showcase: https://youtu.be/EqXlVE2PU1k

data.name: ZombieMode
data.shortDescription: Survive through hordes of puffies in a call of duty black ops zombie inspired game mode
data.description:
**Survive through hordes of puffies in a call of duty black ops zombie inspired game mode; buy weapons to increase survival chances, unlock new areas, upgrade weapons and player stats**

## Installation
1. Download the mod as usual from the RedModManager or manually using the zip file
2. Launch the game and open the installer from the main menu, download the needed content and restart the game
3. **[optional]** If the ingame installer doesn't work you can manually get the files at the [release](https://github.com/ImAxel0/ZombieMode_SOTF/releases) page
3. Play

## Main features:
- Round based system: enemies count increases each round
- Auto health regen (no medicines needed)
- Environment texture changes
- Tweaked inventory: two main weapons selectable with num 1 and 2, grenades with key num 3 (wielded weapon will be swapped with the new one)
- Currently owned weapons UI with their corresponding ammo count
- Mystery box: exchange score points for a random weapon or it's ammunitions
- Wall items: exchange score points for an item or it's ammunitions
- Unlockable metal doors: exchange score points to unlock and discover new areas
- Consumables: on death enemies have a random change of dropping a consumable
- Forge: upgrade some weapons in exchange of score points (pistol and shotgun)
- Vending machines: exchange score points for perks (increased health, movement speed)

### Warning!
The mod uses save slot id number 1234567890, the chance of you having this id in use is almost zero, keep in mind that if this isn't the case it will get overwritten on content installation. You can see your used saves id at `AppData\LocalLow\Endnight\SonsOfTheForest\Saves\SteamId\SinglePlayer` just in case before proceeding with content installation. After installing the content you will have a new save at day 00 that shouldn't be touched.

### Disclaimer
The mod is in an alpha state both for content and bugs state. Feel free to report any probl

data.name: TankMod
data.shortDescription: Drive a tank around and kill cannibals
data.description:
### Spawning the tank
Open the game debug console and type "spawntank" then press enter

### Controls
**Enter the tank**: game interaction key (default E)
**Exit the tank**: G key
**Move**: WASD
**Rotate turret**: Mouse X
**Rotate muzzle**: Mouse Y
**Shoot**: Left mouse button (1.5s delay between each shot)

### Features
-Removes trees along his path and those who are shot (only big ones)
-Can kill enemies, animals etc. with the shot

Additional camera controls in the mod settings. If tank get stuck, spawn a new one -> the previous will get destroyed.
<hr>
Mod was made for fun, no further updates/features are planned.

data.name: HotkeyGUI
data.shortDescription: Let assign up to 36 items to a visible hotkey panel to quickly equip them
data.description:
# <FONT COLOR="#ffff4d">Warning</FONT COLOR>
Needs my `SonsAxLib v1.2.0+` library to work, download it here: https://sotf-mods.com/mods/imaxel/sonsaxlib

#### Description
If you ever felt like opening the inventory to equip an item is too slow, you now have a menu with up to 36 boxes to which you can assign an owned item and equip it with a click. You can only assign currently owned items, using the small red buttons and chosing an item from the list. If an item which you set isn't owned anymore, a red cross will appear on the box, meaning you can't equip it anymore.

**Default opening key is LEFT ALT key. It can be changed from the mods settings.**

Showcase video: https://youtu.be/RAWiyzl6OdE

data.name: Plane Mod
data.shortDescription: Adds an usable plane to the game
data.description:
### How to spawn?
Enable game debug console (type "cheatstick" while playing and press F1) than do "spawnplane" command

### Controls
Interact button to enter, G to exit
W & S for throttle
A & D for yaw
Mouse for pitch & roll
Hold RMB to unlock camera movement

Interact button to enter, circle to exit
Right & Left triggers for throttle
L1 & R1 for yaw
Left stick for pitch & roll
Right stick to rotate camera

### Settings
Additional settings for camera adjustment and pitch/roll direction in the Mods panel (Pause menu -> mods)

### Note
Plane position will be saved and shared globally between savegames
You can spawn a new one at any time
<FONT COLOR="#ffff80">Nicks Mod Menu and/or NoClip mods seems to break this mod causing the player to slide on the ground</FONT COLOR>
